d.ko: Craft, Steal, Brawl and Escape! It’s time to bust out of the toughest prisons in the world as you return to the life of an inmate in The Escapists 2, now with multiplayer! Have you got what it takes to escape?
d.en: Craft, Steal, Brawl and Escape! It’s time to bust out of the toughest prisons in the world as you return to the life of an inmate in The Escapists 2, now with multiplayer! Have you got what it takes to escape?
d.zh: 诡计、偷盗、打架以及逃脱！当你在《The Escapists 2》中回到当一名囚犯的生活时，现在也该通过多玩家模式从世界上最艰苦的监狱中逃脱出来了。你知道逃脱都需要什么吗？
